# Capes

**Category:** Misc  
**Aliases:** Capes

## What it does

Show rusherhack capes on other rusherhack players

Description basis: [publisher description](https://rusherhack.org/features/modules/Capes.html). The module's behavior on a stock Minecraft 26.3 server has not been verified unless separately documented in [research](../../RESEARCH.md).
